{{Term/Store|Stone Talus (Luminous)|Stone Taluses (Luminous)|Series, BotW, TotK|plural}},{{Exp Game|BotW, TotK}}<ref name="BotW Hyrule Compendium"/><ref name="TotK Hyrule Compendium"/> also known as '''Luminous Stone Taluses''',{{Exp Game|TotK}}<ref name="TotK Game Screen"/> and simply as {{Term/Store|Stone Talus|Stone Taluses|AoC|plural}},{{Exp Game|AoC}}<ref name="AoC Game Screen"/> are recurring [[Boss]]es and [[Sub-Boss]]es in {{TLoZ Series}}.

==Characteristics==
==={{BotW|-}}===
{{Compendium/Extract|Stone Talus (Luminous)}}
Stone Taluses (Luminous) are variations of [[Stone Talus]]es, with the notable difference that the [[Ore Deposit]]s on their bodies are [[Luminous Stone Deposit]]s instead.<ref name="BotW Hyrule Compendium 2"/> They hide their massive size by posing as natural rock formations.<ref name="BotW Hyrule Compendium 2"/> Like all Taluses, the only way to damage Stone Taluses (Luminous) is by striking its Luminous Stone Deposit.<ref name="BotW Hyrule Compendium 2"/> They are particularly vulnerable to [[Iron Sledgehammer]]s and other mining tools, as well as [[Bomb Arrow]]s.

After [[Link]] has defeated [[Calamity Ganon]] for the first time, he will be able to ask [[Kilton]] about Taluses.<ref name="BotW Kilton"/> Kilton is unable to approach them due to their giant size, so he asks Link to defeat all of the Talus in [[Hyrule]] so he can analyze their scent.<ref name="BotW Kilton 2"/> This includes all of the Stone Taluses (Luminous). When Link returns to Kilton after defeating all of the Taluses, he will be rewarded with the [[Medal of Honor: Talus]].<ref name="BotW Kilton 3"/> As a result of this research, Kilton is able to learn about the musculoskeletal structure and diet of Taluses.<ref name="BotW Kilton 4"/>

==Other Appearances==
==={{AoC|-}}===
{{Noncanon|Start}}
Luminous Stone Taluses reappear in {{AoC}}, only appearing in the [[Hunting for Gemstones]] [[Challenge]] alongside rare [[Stone Talus (Rare)|Stone Taluses]]. They fight identically to regular [[Stone Talus]]es and drop various rare [[Material]]s, such as [[Ruby|Rubies]] and [[Sapphire]]s.
{{Noncanon|End}}
